note: Source-level genres; individual streams may differ.

name: The Lot Radio
note: Multi-genre radio; show-level genres can differ.

name: DOMMUNE
note: Programme-level details should come from the official programme page.

name: KEXP
note: Do not assume every in-studio session is live on YouTube.

name: Boiler Room
note: Events happen globally; event location overrides operator location.

name: Coachella
note: Festival, stage, stream and performance must be modeled separately.

name: KCRW
note: KCRW records live sessions at its Santa Monica studios; do not assume every session is a YouTube livestream.

name: Audiotree
note: Audiotree records live music sessions in Chicago; stream-level genre and live status require video-level verification.

name: Sofar Sounds
note: Global network operating in hundreds of cities; London is the origin city, not the location of each event. Event location must override this source-level origin.

name: triple j
note: National Australian radio network with studio sessions, festival recordings and event livestreams. Sydney is source-level only; event locations must override it.

name: ARTE Concert
note: Concerts and livestreams originate from many venues and festivals; Strasbourg is operator-level only and must never be used as an event location.

name: Tomorrowland
note: Boom is the event home for Tomorrowland Belgium only; other Tomorrowland editions require their own event location.

name: Q-dance
note: Amsterdam is operator-level only; Defqon.1 and other Q-dance event locations must be modeled separately.

name: Montreux Jazz Festival
operator_name: Fondation du Festival de Jazz de Montreux
note: Montreux is the festival event home; individual stage and performance facts remain stream/event-level.

name: Kiosk Radio
note: The schedule mixes live DJ sets, pre-recorded shows and conversations; ambiguous streams fail closed.

name: Wigmore Hall
note: The 2026/27 season announcement states that concerts are livestreamed regularly throughout the season.

name: Keep Hush
note: Events are global; London is operator-level only and must not be copied to event locations.

name: Seoul Community Radio
note: SCR states that live shows are broadcast regularly; mixed non-music programming remains fail-closed.

name: Mutant Radio
note: Tbilisi is the original broadcast hub; the platform also operates a Berlin studio. Interviews/talks are explicitly excluded from public music-live results.

name: Book Club Radio
note: Book Club Radio states that its live DJ mixes are available on its YouTube channel; Brooklyn is the source base, not a per-event venue claim.

name: DJ Mag
note: DJ Mag runs live streams globally; London is operator base only and must not be used as event location.

name: Mixmag
note: The Lab is a recurring livestream series; individual Lab locations can differ from the London operator base.

name: Beatport
note: Beatport Live events occur in multiple cities; Denver is operator base only.

name: Insomniac
note: Insomniac operates many festivals and events; event-specific locations must override this country-level operator location.

name: UMF TV
note: UMF TV also covers Ultra events outside Miami; event location must override the Miami festival home.

name: A State of Trance
note: The radio show and event series are global; Rotterdam is the documented 2026 event home, not a universal stream location.

name: Club Space
note: Club Space publishes full DJ sets from its Miami venue; stream-level live status still requires YouTube live metadata.

name: South Plug
note: South Plug publishes sessions from multiple cities; Barcelona is a current recurring session city and must not be copied to every stream.

name: Cercle
note: Cercle stages events globally; operator-country coordinates are intentionally not invented.

name: Defected Records
note: Defected mixes archive sets, radio shows and live events; mixed policy must remain strict so a 24/7 archive/radio stream is not treated as live-event proof.
